title: SeisBench DAS: A machine learning framework for Distributed Acoustic Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2609.07558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fibre optic sensing, such as distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), has become a widespread technology for geophysical studies. To process the large-scale datasets produced by DAS, several machine learning methods have been proposed. However, without standardization of data and models, these methods lack comparability and interoperability. This introduces a gap between model developers and practitioners analyzing DAS data and inhibits adoption of deep learning for DAS. To address these limitations, here we present SeisBench DAS, an extension to the SeisBench library for machine learning in seismology. SeisBench DAS defines standard formats for DAS benchmark datasets, including standardised metadata and labels, and DAS models. It builds on the xdas framework for data ingestion and virtual array handling, and on PyTorch for reading and applying the machine learning models. translated_title: SeisBench DAS：一个面向分布式声学传感的机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 光纤传感技术，如分布式声学传感（DAS），已成为地球物理研究中广泛应用的技术。为处理DAS产生的大规模数据集，已有多种机器学习方法被提出。然而，由于缺乏数据和模型的标准化，这些方法缺乏可比性和互操作性。这在模型开发者与分析DAS数据的实践者之间造成了鸿沟，并阻碍了深度学习在DAS领域的应用。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了SeisBench DAS，这是地震学机器学习库SeisBench的一个扩展。SeisBench DAS为DAS基准数据集定义了标准格式，包括标准化的元数据和标签，以及DAS模型的标准。它基于xdas框架实现数据读取和虚拟阵列处理，并基于PyTorch实现机器学习模型的读取和应用。重要的是，SeisBench提供了一个可高效应用深度学习模型的引擎。
tldr: SeisBench DAS通过对DAS数据集和模型进行标准化，搭建了模型开发者与数据分析师之间的桥梁，推动了深度学习在分布式声学传感数据处理中的广泛应用。
en_tdlr: SeisBench DAS standardizes DAS benchmark datasets and models within the SeisBench machine learning framework, bridging the gap between model developers and practitioners and accelerating the adoption of deep learning for Distributed Acoustic Sensing.
